title: Every caption and summary is checked for an 8th-grade reading level
items: Nothing changes on screen. Behind the scenes, every building summary, fact, time-stream caption and tour bubble is now scored for reading level before it can ship.
Copy must read at grade 9 or easier, with no sentence over 20 words, and tour bubbles must stay at 14 words or fewer. The arrival's time-stream captions already pass.
